label: kizuna_dragon_c_02
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh! Why, hello there, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_03
text: I’m sorry. I was lost in thought and didn’t notice\nyour approach.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_04
text: I feel I must again apologize for what transpired\nin the schoolyard...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_select_01
text: It didn’t bother me

label: kizuna_dragon_c_select_02
text: What’re you talking about?

label: kizuna_dragon_c_05a
text: Hah... That is very magnanimous of you.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_05b
text: I’m of course referring to how I rather suddenly\nhad to take my leave while we were still engaged\r\nin conversation.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_06
text: That woman who showed up is a Dragon Tamer—\nand a relative of mine, I might add.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_08
text: You see, I come from a very long line of Trainers\nwho specialize in Dragon-type Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_09
text: There was a child in our family who was expected\nto stand at its head and lead it to greatness.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_10
text: But the young lad, rebellious little fellow that he\nwas, ran away from home one day.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_11
text: He made quite the show of it, too, swearing he’d\n“make a living with music”![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_12
text: A lot happened since then, and...now he’s the art\nteacher and Elite Four member before you![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_13
text: After I so rudely took my leave during our last\nconversation, my dear relative...encouraged me\r\nto give up teaching and return home at last.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_14
text: I’ve been told the current leader of my family—\nthat is to say, my father—is in poor health.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_15
text: Oh, but I do apologize. Perhaps I am not cut out\nfor teaching after all... What sort of teacher\r\ngrumbles on and on at his own student?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_select_03
text: You’re a great teacher!

label: kizuna_dragon_c_select_04
text: I don’t want you to quit teaching!

label: kizuna_dragon_c_16
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, my dear [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... You
have
no
idea
how

your
words

to me.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_17
text: Thank you. Thank you so very much.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_c_system_01
text: You feel trusted by Mr. Hassel!
